statuses.now: Computable now: every input exists in the code and on live.
statuses.after: Computable once reporting runs: the inputs exist in the schema, but have no rows yet.
statuses.decision: Needs a decision first: it conflicts with a standing rule or its scope is unconfirmed.
statuses.data: Needs new data: it is not collected.
statuses.parked: Not proposed: it cannot be done honestly with what exists.

analytics.name: Guest arrivals per month
analytics.source: accommodation_report_versions.arrivals (finalized versions; submitted and draft only in the labeled operational view). 2025: monthly_reports kind municipal_total (12 months on live).
analytics.calc: Sum of arrivals of each place's official version in the month. A guest counts once at each place they arrive at.
analytics.value: Shows how arrivals move through the year and whether a month is above or below the others.
analytics.viz: Column chart by month; the same month last year as a dashed line; coverage band under the axis.
analytics.limits: Arrivals at places, not people. A month with places missing is partial and says so. 2025 is a paper municipal total with no place detail, so it is a separate series until its scope is confirmed (G3).

analytics.name: Guest nights per month
analytics.source: accommodation_report_versions.guest_nights; 2025 monthly_reports.guest_nights.
analytics.calc: Sum of official guest nights. A stay's nights fall in the month they are spent in.
analytics.value: Shows how much stay time the municipality hosts, which arrivals alone hide.
analytics.viz: Column chart by month, aligned to A1 on its own scale.
analytics.limits: Counts only (no revenue). Not comparable with attraction visits.

analytics.name: Average length of stay
analytics.source: accommodation-engine.js averageLengthOfStay = guest nights ÷ arrivals (already in the DAE-1B). 2025 has both inputs.
analytics.calc: Guest nights ÷ arrivals for the month or year, from the same versions.
analytics.value: Tells a manager whether guests stay longer or shorter, and the officer where stays are short.
analytics.viz: Line by month with the year average as a reference line.
analytics.limits: A ratio the DAE-1B already requires, so it is allowed for private places to stay. It is an average: it hides a few long stays.

analytics.name: Occupancy (room-nights occupied of available)
analytics.source: accommodation_report_versions.room_nights_occupied and room_nights_available. 2025 stores rooms and room-nights occupied, not room-nights available.
analytics.calc: Room-nights occupied ÷ room-nights available (accommodation-engine.js occupancyRate). Counts of both are shown beside the rate.
analytics.value: The standard measure of how full places are; the manager sees their own, the officer the municipal total.
analytics.viz: Line by month plus a month × year heat grid once there are two years.
analytics.limits: Needs each place's rooms set up (live: 0 rooms today). The DAE templates define this rate, so it is allowed for private places to stay. For 2025 only occupied room-nights are known, so no rate can be stated (G8).

analytics.name: Peak and low months
analytics.source: The same monthly series as A1 and A2. On live today: 2025, 12 months.
analytics.calc: Rank the months of a year by arrivals (and by guest nights). Peak = the highest, low = the lowest. Seasonality (a typical month) needs at least two full years.
analytics.value: Plan staffing, promotions and closures around the busy and quiet months.
analytics.viz: Column chart with the peak and low labeled, then a month × year heat grid (sequential, one hue).
analytics.limits: One year shows the order of months, not a season. No cause is claimed for a peak. Months with places missing are excluded from the ranking and marked.

analytics.name: Month and year comparison
analytics.source: Versions for the month and the same month a year earlier (FORM A's comparable-month rule in accommodation.js).
analytics.calc: Difference in counts for months with complete coverage in both years. A percentage difference only after the policy decision (G4).
analytics.value: Answers 'are we up or down on last year?' fairly.
analytics.viz: Grouped columns (this year solid, last year muted) with the difference as a number; no dual axis.
analytics.limits: Counts-only policy: percentage change is already built for FORM A (private places to stay) but is not approved elsewhere. First possible comparison is 2027 against 2026 for enterprise data.

analytics.name: Where guests live (residence)
analytics.source: accommodation_report_version_counts (residence_code × male/female; 72 Form A4 rows). 2025 municipal totals have the same rows without sex.
analytics.calc: Sum arrivals by residence group (Philippine residents, non-Philippine residents, overseas Filipinos, unspecified) and by country. 'Unspecified' is shown, never dropped.
analytics.value: Shows which markets the places serve and how many guests are not classified.
analytics.viz: Horizontal bars for the top countries, one stacked bar for the groups with 'unspecified' hatched.
analytics.limits: Shares and percentages need the decision (G4); counts are always shown. Philippine residents are not split by province for places to stay (G7). Rare countries at one small place could identify a guest: manager-only at enterprise level (G15).

analytics.name: Sex of guests
analytics.source: accommodation_report_version_counts.male and .female. 2025 has none (total_unsplit).
analytics.calc: Male and female arrivals for months where the split exists; months without a split are excluded and listed.
analytics.value: Describes the guest mix where it is recorded.
analytics.viz: Two-segment bar by month with a coverage note; or a single number pair.
analytics.limits: Not collected for 2025. Only male and female exist; nothing else is recorded, so nothing else is shown.

analytics.name: Arrivals by weekday and day
analytics.source: accommodation_stays.check_in and accommodation_stay_guests (the manager's own stay register).
analytics.calc: Count arrivals by check-in weekday and by day of the month from the stays of the enterprise (active stays only; voided ones excluded).
analytics.value: Helps a manager set staffing for check-ins.
analytics.viz: Seven-bar weekday chart; a calendar heat grid for the month.
analytics.limits: From the live stay register, so a figure can change until the month is submitted. Stay-level detail stays with the manager; the officer sees monthly versions only (to be confirmed).

analytics.name: Length-of-stay distribution
analytics.source: accommodation_stays.check_in and check_out (nights per stay).
analytics.calc: Number of stays with 1, 2, 3, 4–6, 7+ nights.
analytics.value: Shows whether business is short breaks or long stays, which the average hides.
analytics.viz: Column histogram.
analytics.limits: Counts stays, not guests. Shared rooms and transfers follow the stay register's rules.

analytics.name: Room request funnel (ZTIMS bookings)
analytics.source: bookings.status (requested, confirmed, checked_in, completed, declined, expired, cancelled, no_show) and the enterprise's own settings. Live: 0 bookings.
analytics.calc: Count of requests by outcome in a month. The officer sees counts only, no guest data and no money (as on the Bookings page).
analytics.value: Shows how many requests turn into stays, and how many expire unanswered.
analytics.viz: A horizontal funnel of counts (requested → confirmed → checked in).
analytics.limits: Only requests made through ZTIMS, not all reservations. A booking is never an arrival (only the stay register counts arrivals). Total price exists but is excluded by the no-revenue rule.

analytics.name: Booking lead time and response time
analytics.source: bookings.requested_at, check_in, decided_at.
analytics.calc: Median days from request to check-in; median hours from request to the manager's answer.
analytics.value: Tells a manager how far ahead guests book and how fast they are answered.
analytics.viz: Two number tiles with a small dot-plot of the last 12 requests.
analytics.limits: Needs enough requests to be meaningful (suppress below a minimum count, to decide).

analytics.name: Where room requests come from
analytics.source: bookings.country_code (the booker's country of residence).
analytics.calc: Count of requests by country.
analytics.value: An early signal of markets before stays are reported.
analytics.viz: Horizontal bars.
analytics.limits: Requests, not arrivals or guests. Only ZTIMS requests.

analytics.name: Accommodation by barangay, type and location
analytics.source: spots.barangay, spots.type, spots.latitude and longitude joined to the places' official versions; accommodation_profiles.accommodation_type.
analytics.calc: Sum arrivals and guest nights of the places in each barangay, by place type, and on the map.
analytics.value: Shows where stays concentrate and which barangays have no reporting place.
analytics.viz: Sorted horizontal bars by barangay; map bubbles (the map already exists in tourism-map.js).
analytics.limits: The barangay is where the place is, not where guests live. On live, 10 places to stay are in 3 barangays (Poblacion 7, Maluay 2, Mayabon 1); a barangay with one place shows that place's figures (small-number disclosure, G15).

analytics.name: Attraction visits per month
analytics.source: attraction_report_versions.total (finalized versions); the labeled operational view also takes submitted and draft.
analytics.calc: Sum of the official monthly totals per attraction and across attractions. A month with no usable version is 'not submitted', never 0.
analytics.value: Shows how busy attractions are through the year.
analytics.viz: Column chart by month; the same month last year as a dashed line; coverage band under the axis.
analytics.limits: Visits to attractions, not unique tourists; added across attractions they are still visits. Only office-run, counting attractions exist (2 of 8 on live) (G2). No 2025 attraction data exists.

analytics.name: Daily visits and 7-day average
analytics.source: attraction_daily_counts.total by count_date (operational; locked by the month's submission).
analytics.calc: Daily total with a trailing 7-day mean over recorded days only. Missing days are gaps, confirmed zeros are zeros, closures are marked.
analytics.value: Shows the day-to-day pattern and the busiest days, early, without waiting for the month to be finalized.
analytics.viz: Line with a smoothed average; gaps drawn as gaps; closures as markers.
analytics.limits: Operational until submitted. Counting depends on Support Staff entering every date.

analytics.name: Visits by weekday
analytics.source: attraction_daily_counts grouped by weekday (the date's weekday in Manila).
analytics.calc: Mean visits per recorded open day for each weekday; only dates with a count (zero included) enter, missing and closed dates do not.
analytics.value: Tells staff and the office which days to prepare for.
analytics.viz: Seven columns with the overall mean as a reference line.
analytics.limits: Needs several weeks of data; the number of days behind each bar is shown. Holidays and events are not separated unless overlaid (T10).

analytics.name: Peak and low days and months
analytics.source: The series of T1 and T2.
analytics.calc: Rank recorded days and months by visits.
analytics.value: Identifies pressure points and quiet periods for planning.
analytics.viz: Calendar heat map (one hue, light to dark) for days; labeled columns for months.
analytics.limits: A closure is not a low day. No cause is claimed.

analytics.name: Month and year comparison
analytics.source: Finalized versions for the month and the same month a year earlier.
analytics.calc: Difference in counts over months finalized in both years. Percentage change after the decision (G4).
analytics.value: Shows growth or decline fairly.
analytics.viz: Grouped columns, this year solid and last year muted, with the difference as a number.
analytics.limits: There is no 2025 attraction data, so the first like-for-like year is 2027 (G5). The 2025 municipal totals are not attraction visits and are never used as a baseline.

analytics.name: Visits by attraction
analytics.source: attraction_report_versions joined to spots (title, category, barangay).
analytics.calc: Official visits per attraction for a period, ranked; coverage (months finalized) shown with each.
analytics.value: Shows which attractions carry the load and which are not reporting.
analytics.viz: Ranked horizontal bars; small multiples of the monthly trend per attraction.
analytics.limits: Rankings compare unlike places (a pool and a falls); show the counts without a score. An attraction that is not counted is listed as 'not counted', not as 0.

analytics.name: Visits by barangay and category
analytics.source: spots.barangay, spots.category and spot_more_categories joined to T1.
analytics.calc: Sum visits of the attractions in each barangay and in each category. An attraction with several categories counts under each (stated on the chart).
analytics.value: Shows where visits happen and which kinds of attraction draw them.
analytics.viz: Sorted horizontal bars; map bubbles.
analytics.limits: Barangay is where the attraction is, not where visitors live. Category totals overlap, so they are never added up. Few attractions per barangay: figures are close to a single place's (G15).

analytics.name: Where visitors live (four classes)
analytics.source: attraction_daily_counts residence classes: Zamboanguita, rest of Negros Oriental, other Philippine provinces, foreign; with the completeness flag.
analytics.calc: Sum each class over the period; 'residence not recorded' = total − classified. Never assigned to a class.
analytics.value: Shows local versus outside visitors and how much of the record is classified.
analytics.viz: One stacked horizontal bar with 'not recorded' hatched, and the counts beside it.
analytics.limits: Optional field: the unclassified share can be large (shown). Shares need the decision (G4). Only four classes: no countries for foreign visitors (G7).

analytics.name: Sex of visitors
analytics.source: attraction_daily_counts.male and .female with the completeness flag.
analytics.calc: Sum male and female; 'not recorded' = total − male − female.
analytics.value: Describes the visitor mix where recorded.
analytics.viz: Two-segment bar with a hatched 'not recorded' segment.
analytics.limits: Sex by residence is never stored, so a cross-tabulation is never shown.

analytics.name: Visits around announced events and closures
analytics.source: announcements (category event or closure, starts_at, ends_at, optional spot_id) and spot_closed_dates, over T2.
analytics.calc: Mark event and closure dates on the daily series; compare the mean of event days with other days of the same weekday.
analytics.value: Lets the office see whether an event moves visits, without guessing.
analytics.viz: Daily line with shaded event bands and closure markers.
analytics.limits: Only events the office posted; there is no holiday or fiesta calendar (G13). Association, never cause.

analytics.name: Interest signals: saves and ratings
analytics.source: saved_places (visitor × place), reviews.rating for visible reviews; visitor accounts. Live: 1 account, 0 saves, 0 reviews.
analytics.calc: Count of saves per place; average rating and number of visible reviews (a review requires a used ticket or completed stay).
analytics.value: Shows interest and satisfaction beside the counted visits.
analytics.viz: Bars of saves; a rating with its count.
analytics.limits: A save is not a visit. Reviews need a visit proof that exists only for ticket or booking visits, so they cover a small part of the visitors. Not added to any visit count.

analytics.name: Visits per open day
analytics.source: attraction_daily_counts and spot_closed_dates, spots.working_days.
analytics.calc: Total visits ÷ dates counted (zero days included, closed and missing excluded).
analytics.value: Compares months of different length and attractions with different opening days.
analytics.viz: Number tile and line by month.
analytics.limits: A mean of daily counts; not a capacity measure (no capacity data exists, G17).

analytics.name: Reporting completeness
analytics.source: accommodation tracker states and attraction tracker states (already built), accommodation_periods, attraction_periods, spots.counts_visitors, support_staff.
analytics.calc: For each month and domain: places expected, submitted, finalized, missing, with no staff or not counted. Shown under every chart as a coverage band.
analytics.value: Tells every reader how much of the picture is in before they trust a number.
analytics.viz: A coverage band (segmented bar) per month; the existing tracker grid for detail.
analytics.limits: 'Expected' is the places that count visitors or have set up reporting; places that never started are not expected (shown separately). The 5th-of-the-month deadline is a ZTIMS target.

analytics.name: Unclassified share of the record
analytics.source: Residence and sex 'not recorded' counts from A7, A8, T8 and T9.
analytics.calc: Count of arrivals or visits with no residence (or no sex) recorded, per month.
analytics.value: Shows whether residence and sex charts can be trusted for a month.
analytics.viz: A small hatched segment on each breakdown chart, plus a line of counts.
analytics.limits: A count, not a percentage, unless G4 is decided.

analytics.name: Timeliness of reports
analytics.source: accommodation_report_versions.late and submitted_at; attraction_period_events (submitted).
analytics.calc: Days between month end and submission; count submitted after the 5th.
analytics.value: Shows which places need a reminder.
analytics.viz: A dot per place and month (on time or late); the existing tracker colors.
analytics.limits: The 5th is a ZTIMS target, not an official deadline.

analytics.name: Municipal overview: two panels on one month axis
analytics.source: A1 and T1.
analytics.calc: Accommodation arrivals and attraction visits shown in separate panels that share the month axis. Never summed, never indexed together.
analytics.value: Lets the officer read both without mistaking one for the other.
analytics.viz: Two aligned small-multiple charts, each with its own scale and its own coverage band.
analytics.limits: No verified deduplication exists (G9), so the two can never be combined into 'unique tourists' or 'total tourists'.

analytics.name: Data gaps panel
analytics.source: spots (counts_visitors, status, managed_by), support_staff, accommodation_profiles, accommodation_rooms.
analytics.calc: List attractions not counted, counting attractions with no Support Staff, places to stay with no rooms or no reporting start, private attractions with no reporting path.
analytics.value: Turns 'missing data' into a to-do list for the office.
analytics.viz: A checklist with counts, each linking to the page that fixes it.
analytics.limits: Describes setup, not the quality of what was entered.

analytics.name: Unique tourists / total tourists
analytics.source: None.
analytics.calc: Would need one identifier across places, which does not exist. Arrivals and visits repeat across places by design.
analytics.value: A headline number many readers expect.
analytics.viz: Not shown.
analytics.limits: No verified deduplication (G9). Do not combine arrivals and visits.

analytics.name: Revenue, average spend, RevPAR, ADR
analytics.source: bookings.total_amount and payments exist but are excluded.
analytics.calc: Not computed.
analytics.value: Economic impact.
analytics.viz: Not shown.
analytics.limits: The office asked for revenue to stay out of statistics (G16).

analytics.name: Purpose of visit, age groups, same-day versus overnight
analytics.source: Not collected (tickets hold regular, student and child counts for demo data only).
analytics.calc: Not computed.
analytics.value: Market segmentation.
analytics.viz: Not shown.
analytics.limits: Would need new fields at the point of counting (G10); the 'Same Day Visitors' title is not claimed (decision D4).
